spec: TEEPIN-STORAGE-DESIGN.md 28.3, 28.17 and 28.25: the planner (next pack) and the timing rule (decide)
notes: planner: each case's items are [key, stored bytes, reserve-request bytes]; plan pack after pack (with
the tail when tail is true) until no item is left; packs lists each pack's item indexes, state and stored
bytes. limits.request_budget is the bytes a reserve body's objects may take.
repeat: items are count copies of {key with {i} its index, stored, request}.
decide: arrivals are [time, stored bytes] of saves that arrived able to join, without the oldest's own;
decision.at is only meaningful for kind wait (0 otherwise); reason is null at or over the floor.
decide (28.25): coming is the stored bytes of the bucket's packs in flight expected back by the oldest's
time limit; contested is true while another pack waits for a slot or settles; behind is true while a
later write to a key in the pack waits behind it. limits.observe is in seconds, like wait.
planner_saves (28.25): one pack of a save's queue, its tail taken within tail_cap stored bytes (null:
no tail); pack lists its item indexes, the indexes left, its state and stored bytes.
remnant (28.25): whether a full pack's rest is alone: rest bytes + coming + its own arrivals in the
window (without its oldest's) at their rate for its oldest's time left stay under the floor.
absorb_cap (28.25): min(ceiling + floor, the pack cap, request_bytes when not null).
